items.t: JardogsHealth Forms Strategic Advisory Council with Leaders from Discover Card, MTV, DoorDash and Apple
items.sum: JardogsHealth, the AI operating layer for healthcare, today announced the formation of the JardogsHealth Strategic Advisory Council, four executives who reached the top of financial services, media, startups and technology. The council will advise JardogsHealth leadership on long-term strategy, growth, product direction and brand as the company brings the JardogsHealth Care Platform to more health
